name: @quest-n-click/engine

scripts.build: npm run check && npm run build:game
scripts.test:coverage: vitest run --coverage --exclude tests/ownership.test.ts --exclude tests/audit.test.ts --exclude tests/canonical.test.ts --exclude tests/memo.test.ts --exclude tests/reference-proof.test.ts --exclude tests/solver-oracle.test.ts --exclude tests/dominance.test.ts --exclude tests/partition.test.ts --exclude tests/checkpoint-matrix.test.ts
scripts.test:node: vitest run --exclude tests/pixel.test.ts --exclude tests/studio-assets.test.ts --exclude tests/ownership.test.ts --exclude tests/audit.test.ts --exclude tests/canonical.test.ts --exclude tests/memo.test.ts --exclude tests/reference-proof.test.ts --exclude tests/solver-oracle.test.ts --exclude tests/dominance.test.ts --exclude tests/partition.test.ts --exclude tests/checkpoint-matrix.test.ts
scripts.check: tsx tools/select-game.ts && npm run -s tsc -- --noEmit && npm run test:node
scripts.verify:game: npm run validate && npm run solve && npm run solve -- --chapters && npm run verify:variants && npm run i18n -- status && npm run lint && npm run playtests
scripts.prove:game: npm run solve -- --prove && npm run solve -- --prove --chapters && npm run solve:reality
scripts.release-check: npm run doctor -- --release && npm run quality && npm run build && npm run test:coverage && npx tsx tools/coverage-ratchet.ts --strict && npm run verify:release && npm run prove:game && npm run solve -- --audit-abstractions && npm run reality:xcheck -- --require-rust && npm run test:mutation:core -- --set=all && node scripts/pack.mjs --out=.cache/pack --publish-dry-run && npm run audit:deps && npm audit --audit-level=high
scripts.release-check:ci: npm run doctor -- --release && npm run quality && npm run build && npm run test:coverage -- --reporter=default --reporter=github-actions --reporter=json --outputFile.json=.cache/test-report/vitest.json && npx tsx tools/coverage-ratchet.ts --strict && npm run verify:release && npm run prove:game && npm run solve -- --audit-abstractions && npm run reality:xcheck -- --require-rust && node scripts/pack.mjs --out=.cache/pack --publish-dry-run && npm run audit:deps && npm audit --audit-level=high
scripts.release-check:local: npm run quality && npm run docs:truth && npm run test:node && npm run build:game && npm run quality:baseline -- --check --dist
scripts.quality: npm run format:check && npm run lint:code && knip --no-progress && npm run -s tsc -- --noEmit && npm run -s tsc -- --noEmit -p tsconfig.strictest.json && npm run lint:content
scripts.assets: node -e "require('node:fs').mkdirSync('.cache',{recursive:true})" && tsx --tsconfig tsconfig.json tools/refs.ts > .cache/refs.json && python3 tools/assets.py
scripts.build:studio-demo: tsx tools/select-game.ts && cross-env STUDIO=1 VITE_STUDIO_DEMO=1 vite build
scripts.verify:release: npm run validate -- --release && npm run weight -- --release && npm run i18n -- status && npm run voices -- check --release && npm run playtests -- --strict
scripts.verify:commercial: npm run verify:release && npm run validate -- --commercial --errors && npm run verify:dist
scripts.verify:field: npm run verify:commercial && npm run playtests -- --strict --require=5 --require-completed=3 --require-devices=2
scripts.test:heavy: vitest run --no-file-parallelism tests/ownership.test.ts tests/audit.test.ts tests/canonical.test.ts tests/memo.test.ts tests/reference-proof.test.ts tests/solver-oracle.test.ts tests/dominance.test.ts tests/partition.test.ts tests/checkpoint-matrix.test.ts
scripts.build:game: npm run verify:game && vite build && npm run verify:dist && npm run check:spoilers && npm run audit:assets

description: Mobile-first SCUMM-style point-and-click engine with authoring tools and an AI-friendly workflow
